name: Kuchiba Naruomi
source:
Resident of Room 207. A prudent young man with calm and careful judgment. He is a serious person, but can be inflexible at times. He's always concerned about Hisora, but according to him, they're not exactly acquaintances.

[Source [URL=http://www.zombilica.com/games/nienomati/character.html] official website profile.[/URL]]
